notes.description: SKILL.md frontmatter 的 description 不在此处维护，打包时直接取源 skill 的 description（触发语义单一真源），本文件只维护市场展示面字段。
notes.pricing: 定价不在 zip 包内，上传后在开放平台「收入变现」后台选择一次性买断或按月订阅；此处仅为建议值。

ios-engineer.route_hint: iOS 崩溃 / 并发 / 布局 / 性能 / 审查 / 迁移
ios-engineer.description_zh: 覆盖 iOS / iPadOS / macOS(Catalyst) / watchOS / tvOS 的工程技能：架构与并发建模、崩溃与野指针定位、SwiftUI/UIKit 布局错位、性能与能耗排查、代码审查、重构迁移与测试策略。每份方案强制给出「版本前提」与「残留风险」双声明。
ios-engineer.description_en: Senior-level Apple-platform engineering skill: architecture and Swift concurrency modeling, crash and dangling-pointer debugging, SwiftUI/UIKit layout defects, performance and energy profiling, code review, refactoring, migration and test strategy. Every deliverable ships explicit version assumptions and a residual-risk statement.
examples_zh: 帮我定位这个 EXC_BAD_ACCESS 崩溃的根因
SwiftUI 列表滚动时跳动，给出最小修复
把这段回调式网络层迁移到 async/await
examples_en: Find the root cause of this EXC_BAD_ACCESS crash
My SwiftUI list jumps while scrolling — give the minimal fix
Migrate this callback-based networking layer to async/await

pricing.note: Swift / Xcode 版本知识需持续更新，适合订阅

ios-engineer.notes: ios-engineer/scripts/、i18n/、agents/ 为仓库工具与本地化资产，不属于运行期知识，不上架；平台仅支持 根/二级目录/文件 三段路径，依赖内联拍平为 references/dep-<dep>--*.md；references 中对 ../scripts 的链接在打包时降级为纯文本。

cognitive-reasoning.route_hint: 论证质量、隐藏假设、最强反驳、认知拓展
cognitive-reasoning.description_zh: 给 Agent 装上论证纪律：结论强度校验、外部真值接地、认知对手模式（主动寻找最强反驳）、回复末尾认知拓展尾注，防止迎合式结论与信息茧房。
cognitive-reasoning.description_en: Argumentation discipline for AI agents: claim-strength checks, grounding to verifiable facts, a cognitive-adversary mode that hunts the strongest counterargument, and a short cognitive footnote that breaks filter bubbles.
examples_zh: 审查这段推理有没有隐藏假设
用最强反驳挑战我的结论
这个判断的可证伪条件是什么
examples_en: Check this reasoning for hidden assumptions
Challenge my conclusion with the strongest counterargument
What would falsify this judgment?

pricing.note: 低价订阅引流，同时是 ios-engineer 的内联依赖

engineering-discipline.route_hint: 工程安全、最小修复、四段式、残留风险
engineering-discipline.description_zh: 工程任务的安全网：安全合规防御、危险操作前置确认、单根因归因、四段式输出、最小修复、预算拦截与残留风险声明。
engineering-discipline.description_en: A safety net for engineering tasks: security and compliance guardrails, confirmation before risky actions, single-root-cause attribution, structured four-part answers, minimal fixes, budget stops and residual-risk statements.
examples_zh: 执行这个改动前需要我确认什么
按最小修复原则改这个 bug
列出这次改动没覆盖到的风险
examples_en: What should you confirm before making this change?
Fix this bug with the minimal possible diff
List the risks this change does not cover

pricing.note: 免费引流，用于满足「先有 1 个审核通过的免费技能」的开通收款前提

problem-analysis.route_hint: 需求提法检验、第一性原理拆解
problem-analysis.description_zh: 先检验问题再动手：逻辑一致性检验、第一性原理拆解、充分理解后再作答，避免把错误前提当成需求直接实现。
problem-analysis.description_en: Analyze before acting: logic-consistency checks, first-principles decomposition, and an explicit restatement of the real problem before any solution is proposed.
examples_zh: 先帮我检验这个需求提法是否成立
用第一性原理拆解这个性能问题
我这个判断哪里逻辑不自洽
examples_en: Check whether this requirement statement even holds
Decompose this performance problem from first principles
Where is my reasoning inconsistent?

plan-grill.description_zh: 动手前先盘问：对非平凡需求逐问澄清阻塞性决策，一次只问一个，锁定后产出 PLAN.md，避免做完才发现方向错了。
plan-grill.description_en: Interrogate the request before building: surface blocking decisions one question at a time, then lock the result into a PLAN.md so work never starts on the wrong premise.
examples_zh: 帮我把这个需求盘问清楚再动手
给我这个功能的 PLAN.md
这个需求里有哪些还没说清的决策
examples_en: Grill me on this requirement before you start building
Produce a PLAN.md for this feature
Which decisions in this request are still undefined?

pricing.note: 流程稳定、更新少，适合买断

cross-model-review.description_zh: 把 PLAN.md 交给两个不同厂商的模型做对抗审查，主 Agent 仲裁并给出 APPROVED / REVISE 结论与逐轮审查日志。
cross-model-review.description_en: Send a PLAN.md to two models from different providers for adversarial review; the primary agent arbitrates and returns APPROVED / REVISE with a per-round review log.
examples_zh: 用两个模型对抗审查这份 PLAN.md
审查这个方案并给出 REVISE 理由
把审查结论写进 PLAN-REVIEW-LOG
examples_en: Run an adversarial review of this PLAN.md with two models
Review this plan and explain why it should be REVISE
Write the review verdict into PLAN-REVIEW-LOG

pricing.note: 依赖外部 CLI 演进，适合订阅

auto-code-review.route_hint: 改动 / PR 的跨模型审查
auto-code-review.description_zh: 显式触发的跨模型代码审查：reviewer 只读运行、变更范围可追溯、最多三轮收敛，未收敛输出 deadlock 而不是假装通过；默认不改代码，授权后才修。
auto-code-review.description_en: Explicitly triggered cross-model code review: read-only reviewers, traceable diff scope, at most three rounds, and deadlock instead of fake approval. Code stays untouched unless you explicitly authorize a fix.
examples_zh: /auto-review 审查本次改动
让两个模型 review 这个 PR
审查并修复这个模块的并发问题
examples_en: /auto-review this change
Have two models review this pull request
Review and fix the concurrency bug in this module

pricing.note: 依赖外部 CLI 与历史线索，适合订阅

checkpoint-persist.description_zh: 长任务防失忆：多子项任务每产出一个关键结论就增量写入 checkpoint 文件，上下文超窗或压缩后仍能续接。
checkpoint-persist.description_en: Anti-amnesia for long tasks: every key sub-result is appended to a checkpoint file as soon as it is produced, so work survives context compaction.
examples_zh: 这个长任务帮我边做边落盘
上下文要超了，先把已产出的结论存下来
从 checkpoint 恢复上次的进度
examples_en: Persist intermediate results as you work through this long task
Context is nearly full — checkpoint what we have so far
Resume the previous run from its checkpoint

historical-recall.route_hint: 召回项目历史决策线索
historical-recall.description_zh: 动手前先召回历史：每个任务开始时 best-effort 检索 .plan-reviews/ 里的既往决策与审查线索，避免重复踩坑。
historical-recall.description_en: Recall before acting: best-effort retrieval of past decisions and review findings from .plan-reviews/ at the start of every task.
examples_zh: 开工前先召回这个项目的历史决策
之前有没有讨论过这个方案
把相关历史线索作为待验证上下文给我
examples_en: Recall this project's past decisions before starting
Have we discussed this approach before?
Give me the relevant historical findings as unverified context

pricing.note: 免费引流，同时是 auto-code-review / prompt-optimizer 的内联依赖

doc-hygiene.route_hint: 文档最终态表述、去过程叙事
doc-hygiene.description_zh: 文档只写最终态事实：禁止把迁移过程、owner 纠正、历史承载写进 .md 正文，变更过程一律进 CHANGELOG。
doc-hygiene.description_en: Keep docs in final-state voice: no migration narratives or change-process prose in .md bodies — the process belongs in CHANGELOG.
examples_zh: 帮我把这篇文档改成最终态表述
检查这段文档有没有过程叙事
这段改动该写进 CHANGELOG 还是文档正文
examples_en: Rewrite this doc in final-state voice
Check this doc for process narrative
Should this change go into CHANGELOG or the doc body?

project-decision-evaluation.route_hint: 立项 / Go-No-Go / 项目排序
project-decision-evaluation.description_zh: 立项 / Go-No-Go / 组合排序：用证据门禁、统一评分与停止条件判断一个项目该启动、验证、暂缓还是终止，并给出复盘节奏。
project-decision-evaluation.description_en: Go/No-Go and portfolio decisions: evidence gates, one scoring rubric and explicit stop conditions to decide whether to start, validate, pause or kill a project — plus a review cadence.
examples_zh: 这个方向该不该立项
给这三个候选项目排序
设定这个项目的停止条件与复盘节奏
examples_en: Should we green-light this direction?
Rank these three candidate projects
Define stop conditions and a review cadence for this project

pricing.note: 框架完整、更新少，参考市场同类买断价

classics-reading.route_hint: 古籍章句解读、争议注疏
classics-reading.description_zh: 克制型古籍解读：版本先行、标注出处、并列争议注疏，字面义 / 注疏义 / 个人推演三层分离，「无定论、无出处」也是合法结论。
classics-reading.description_en: Restrained reading of Chinese classics: source edition first, citations always given, competing commentaries side by side, and a strict split between literal meaning, commentary and personal inference — 'undetermined' is a valid answer.
examples_zh: 解释《道德经》这一章
这句古文有哪些争议注疏
区分这句话的字面义和后世推演
examples_en: Explain this chapter of the Daodejing
What competing commentaries exist for this line?
Separate the literal meaning from later inference

prompt-optimizer.route_hint: 改写 / 优化提问与 prompt
prompt-optimizer.description_zh: 把模糊提问改写成结构化高质量提示词：先召回相似历史，再盘问澄清真实需求，透明展示供你确认，确认后才基于它回答。
prompt-optimizer.description_en: Rewrite vague requests into structured, high-quality prompts: recall similar past questions, clarify the real need, show the rewritten prompt for approval, then answer from it.
examples_zh: 帮我优化提问：登录接口要加限流
优化这个 prompt
改写我的问题，让它更清楚
examples_en: Help me refine this question: add rate limiting to the login API
Optimize this prompt
Rewrite my question to make it clearer
